conditions.otherWorkloads: Other development servers, another iOS simulator, an Android emulator, and browser automation remained active. No unrelated processes were stopped.
conditions.swap: Approximately 17 GiB in use after setup; host load varied materially.
conditions.timingDiscipline: All builds completed before each accepted inference run; only one study inference loop ran at a time. Read-only checks and lightweight report editing continued.
conditions.cache: One excluded warmup and four measured fresh-context reloads per model; OS file cache not flushed.
conditions.ui: Streaming adapter/API delivery, not normal chat rendering, tools, retrieval, or image input.

Thimvale.note: This study adds opt-in test instrumentation; the native inference implementation is unchanged.

PocketPal.note: Frozen Yarn dependencies; pod lockfile changed only its CocoaPods tool-version footer. Test-only automation patch; no engine changes.

LLMFarm.note: Used the repository-supplied CPU XCFramework, not a rebuilt engine. The checked-out llama source revision is not asserted to be the provenance of that prebuilt binary.

excludedPilots: Initial LLMFarm run overlapped build activity and omitted automatic BOS insertion.
Initial PocketPal run overlapped JS rebundling, lacked raw events, registered GPU devices, and used repeat penalty 1.
Final PocketPal single-Gemma counter/CPU calibration used zero measured repetitions; excluded from speed summaries.
